```{r global, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(knitr.duplicate.label = "allow")

library(flexdashboard)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)

source("R/gage_config.R")
source("R/fetch_discharge.R")
source("R/fetch_snowpack.R")
source("R/plot_helpers.R")

# Fetch everything once up front (one NWIS/SNOTEL round-trip per gage/station,
# not per chart) and cache SNOTEL pulls since several gages share a station.
gage_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(gage_config)), function(i) {
  gage <- gage_config[i, ]
  daily <- fetch_daily_discharge(gage$site_no)
  stats <- fetch_daily_stats(gage$site_no)
  cc <- current_conditions(daily, stats)
  list(gage = gage, daily = daily, stats = stats, cc = cc)
})

snotel_cache <- new.env()
fetch_snowpack_cached <- function(snotel_id) {
  key <- as.character(snotel_id)
  if (is.null(snotel_cache[[key]])) {
    snotel_cache[[key]] <- tryCatch(fetch_snowpack(snotel_id), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  snotel_cache[[key]]
}
```

### Current conditions across all gages

```{r}
overview <- do.call(rbind, lapply(gage_data, function(x) {
  data.frame(
    Gage = x$gage$common_name,
    Type = ifelse(x$gage$is_tributary, "Tributary", "Mainstem"),
    `As of` = as.character(x$cc$as_of),
    `Q (cfs)` = round(x$cc$q_cfs, 1),
    `% of normal` = ifelse(is.na(x$cc$pct_of_normal), NA, paste0(x$cc$pct_of_normal, "%")),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))
knitr::kable(overview)
```

```{r gage-pages, include=FALSE}
pages <- lapply(gage_data, function(x) {
  gage <- x$gage
  daily <- x$daily
  stats <- x$stats
  cc <- x$cc
  swe <- fetch_snowpack_cached(gage$snotel_id)
  swe_cc <- if (!is.null(swe)) snowpack_current_vs_normal(swe) else NULL
  knitr::knit_child("_gage_page.Rmd", envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE)
})
```

```{r render-pages, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat(paste(unlist(pages), collapse = '\n'))
```
